claims.title: Once-counted distinct-port three-block signed Heisenberg cancellation
claims.ledger_status: PROJECT ANALYTIC PROOF + INDEPENDENT INTERNAL REVIEW + EXACT FINITE CONTROLS; NO ANALYTIC FORMALIZATION
claims.boundary: Unchanged fixed tau=10^-80, odd N; once-counted ordered coordinate-word pairs admitting distinct-port nonempty three-block reversal, all link lengths, smooth compact positive Heisenberg band. Normalized error O_w((log N)^5/N) plus superpolynomial and exponential terms. Repeated ports, general and growing reconnection complexity, plateau restoration and higher factorial comparison remain open. TRACE-005 and BGS-BGS-001 remain OPEN. No effective startup, global priority, external referee or analytic formalization claim. Combinatorial proof requires only unitarity, flat entries and P mixing; actual-model input is FM-021, and these hypotheses are not a spectral-universality criterion.
